# Muhammad Hamza Khan

> Muhammad Hamza Khan is a Senior Software Engineer and backend architect in Islamabad, Pakistan. Over six years designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ERP systems, API ecosystems and integrations. Also offers SEO, AEO and GEO (search, answer and generative engine optimisation). Available for freelance projects worldwide.
